about: NAFEMS linear-elastic benchmarks used by gap 05. The original NAFEMS publication (The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, Oct 1990) is a paid NAFEMS document; its target values are reproduced publicly by solver vendors' verification manuals and by open-source projects (sources listed per case). Geometry/BCs below are taken from the public FeenoX example files (GPL-3.0, pinned commit) and agree with the vendor manuals' descriptions. Files are pinned by URL + sha256, not redistributed (GPL).

geometry.description: quarter of an elliptic ring; inner ellipse x^2/2000^2 + y^2/1000^2 = 1, outer ellipse x^2/3250^2 + y^2/2750^2 = 1, first quadrant

cases.load: uniform outward normal pressure (tension) 10 MPa on outer elliptic edge BC

acceptance.mesh: quadratic elements (CPS8/quad8/tri6 or S8 with membrane only), >= the 'fine' NAFEMS density
acceptance.note: tolerance is llull's choice; Abaqus CPS8 fine mesh gives 92.81 MPa (0.12 %)

cases.benchmark: NAFEMS LE10 thick plate under pressure (3D)

geometry.description: quarter elliptic annular plate, same planform as LE1 (inner 2000 x 1000, outer 3250 x 2750), thickness 600 mm, mid-plane at z = 0

cases.load: uniform normal pressure 1 MPa on the upper face (z = +300)

target.sign_note: compressive; some manuals print the magnitude 5.38

acceptance.mesh: quadratic tetrahedra (C3D10/CTETRA10) locally refined at D
acceptance.note: tolerance is llull's choice; Abaqus fine meshes report -5.51 to -5.89 MPa depending on element (search-verified), FeenoX tet10 reports -5.37968
